pin_diff.note: Functionally identical VIN pin (VIN vs IN).
Functionally identical EN pin (Shutdown vs EN).
Pin 4 differs (NC/ADJ/NC vs NC/NR/BYPASS): safe only if PCB leaves Pin 4 floating or decoupled via 10 nF to GND; if PCB ties NC pin directly to GND/VIN, trace cut is mandatory.
Functionally identical VOUT pin (VOUT vs OUT).

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=2.2 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH PIN 4 (NC vs BYPASS/NR) CHECK: One device uses Pin 4 as an internal bandgap bypass/noise-reduction node while the other is NC. Verify Pin 4 is NOT tied to GND or VIN on the existing PCB before swapping; add a 10 nF bypass cap if low noise is required.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AP2127K-3.3TRG1: 1 µF p.12 vs TPS79333DBVR: 2.2 µF p.4); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS79333DBVR supplies up to 200 mA (p.5) compared to AP2127K-3.3TRG1 at 300 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 37% higher on AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (AP2127K-3.3TRG1: 250 °C/W p.4 vs TPS79333DBVR: 182.3 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2127K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA) vs TPS79333DBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2127K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TPS79333DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS difference; minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 63.8 °C on AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 250 °C/W) vs 46.5 °C on TPS79333DBVR (θJA 182.3 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 4.2x ratio (60 µA (p.5) vs 250 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 "High 250 °C/W SOT-23-5 θJA Caps Continuous Power at 400 mW (25°C) — Derate From 5 V" (p.13) and TPS79333DBVR "CRITICAL Mixed Legacy (CSO:DLN) vs New Chip (CSO:RFB) Silicon Lottery on Non-M3 OPN" (p.28). BOM decision: Choose AP2127K-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 200 mA (up to 300 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 60 µA Iq; choose TPS79333DBVR when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 112 mV dropout or lower package θJA (182.3 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
